svg.title: Degree and traversal analysis for one edge-aligned ReusePlan
svg.desc: Four numbered bands derive a ReusePlan for the checked adjacency entry adjacency entry 4->7 (internal 8->18). The figure shows selected CSR rows, degree-derived tiering, subsequent property-line accesses, compact packing, and the offline/measured-runtime boundary.
svg.text: Degree and traversal analysis for one edge-aligned ReusePlan
The concrete values come from fig/ecg-figure-fixture.json and its executable test.
9 vertices, 17 undirected edges; unused internal IDs omitted
fixture IDs 0..8; node color shows internal property tier
outgoing traversal: sort by d_in, then vertex ID
tier 0 is reserved for invalid metadata
search begins after the current outer vertex
epoch = floor(u * 32 / 32); same-row line accesses are preserved; ID order wraps at |V|
preprocessing produces an immutable runtime input
builder executes outside the measured ROI
